problem.body: Kids are full of ideas, but one-size-fits-all curriculums and limited access to mentors mean their unique interests rarely get to grow.

step1.title: Tell your story
step1.body: Your child describes their passions through a fun storytelling activity. Our AI reads between the lines to reveal hidden interests and learning styles.

step2.title: Pick your mission
step2.body: Get a personalised 7-day adventure tailored to your child's unique interests — using only what you already have at home.

step3.title: Daily mentorship
step3.body: Each day an AI mentor guides your child through creative challenges, celebrates progress, and gently adapts to their pace and mood.

step4.title: Global showcase
step4.body: Share completed missions with children worldwide. Discover different perspectives, vote on favourites, and find your Squad.

step5.title: Continued growth
step5.body: Watch your child evolve from curious explorer to confident creator — with personalised insights and recommended next adventures.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we protect your child's data
privacy.intro: Katalis is committed to protecting the privacy and safety of children. This page explains how we collect, use, and protect data in compliance with COPPA and international child privacy standards.

dataRetention.title: Data Retention
dataRetention.mentorChat: Mentor chat messages are kept for up to 6 months.
dataRetention.reflections: Reflections and voice recordings are kept for up to 1 year.
dataRetention.discoveryArtifacts: Discovery artwork and recordings are removed after 1 year.
dataRetention.interestSignals: Behavioral interest signals are aggregated after 2 years.
dataRetention.auditLogs: Action logs are kept for at least 2 years for safety.

yourRights.title: Your Rights
yourRights.deletion: Parents can request complete data deletion at any time from the parent dashboard.
yourRights.access: Parents can view all data stored about their child.
yourRights.sla: Deletion requests are fulfilled within 30 days.

contact.title: Contact
contact.text: For privacy questions or data deletion requests, contact us at:

privacy.noTracking: We do not use advertising trackers or sell any data.
privacy.coppa: This platform is designed for children aged 3–12 and complies with COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act).

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.intro: Katalis uses only strictly necessary cookies required for the service to function. No advertising, analytics, or tracking cookies are used — no cookie consent banner is required.

rows.name: katalis-session
rows.purpose: Authenticates the logged-in parent or child session. Contains only an encrypted user ID and role — no personal data.

rows.name: katalis_guest_id
rows.purpose: Identifies a guest upload session so files can be linked to the correct visitor. Issued only when a guest uploads a file.

rows.name: NEXT_LOCALE
rows.purpose: Remembers the user's selected language (en / id / zh).

cookies.localStorage: Additionally, two browser storage keys (katalis_guest_id and katalis_guest_history) are saved in localStorage — not cookies — to support the guest discovery experience without a server round-trip. These are cleared when browser storage is cleared.
